_comment: Dependency: jq (Claude Code passes hook input as JSON on stdin). Every hook prechecks for jq: the Edit|Write hooks exit 2 with a distinct HOOK ERROR if it is missing; the Skill logger silently skips. Exit-code semantics: in PreToolUse, exit 2 is the only code that BLOCKS the tool call — exit 1 is a non-blocking error and the edit would still proceed. The PostToolUse formatter only touches files inside $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so edits to sibling repos in a multi-repo workspace are never reformatted under flow-frontend's Prettier config.
_comment_blocklist: The PreToolUse guard blocks two categories with category-accurate messages: generated/lock/CI files (do not edit manually — regenerate instead) and env files (user-managed local config/secrets — ask the user to edit them). Exception: .env.development is exempt because the e2e-test-fixture skill and the workspace docs instruct editing it for local auth (e.g. OKTA_ISSUER).
_comment_skill_log: The PreToolUse Skill hook appends one JSON line {skill, ts} per skill invocation to $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skill-usage.jsonl so under-triggered skills can be spotted. It is fail-open: any failure (missing jq, unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, unparseable input) still exits 0 — logging never blocks a tool call. Add .claude/skill-usage.jsonl to the target project's .gitignore.
_comment_plugins: enabledPlugins are Claude Code marketplace plugins: frontend-design = Figma/visual design inspection for the design-reviewer and ui-builder workflows; playwright = the playwright-test MCP server the playwright-* agents require; typescript-lsp = TypeScript language-server intellisense. Verify these marketplace names against your Claude Code plugin directory before enabling.

hooks.command: if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'HOOK ERROR: jq is not installed — required to parse hook input. Install jq (brew install jq).' >&2; exit 2; fi; input=$(cat); filepath=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -z "$filepath" ]; then echo 'HOOK ERROR: could not read .tool_input.file_path from stdin JSON — Claude Code hook input format may have changed. Failing loudly rather than skipping the generated-file guard.' >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$filepath" in *.env.development) exit 0;; */lib/openapi/*|*/generated/*|*/examples/gen/*|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/.github/*) echo 'BLOCK: This is a generated, lock, or CI file — do not edit manually; regenerate it with the appropriate tool instead.' >&2; exit 2;; *.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCK: This is an environment file containing user-managed local config/secrets — ask the user to edit it themselves. (Only .env.development is exempt, for local auth setup.)' >&2; exit 2;; *) exit 0;; esac

{ input=$(cat) && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude" && printf '%s' "$input" | jq -c 'select(.tool_input.skill != null and .tool_input.skill != "") | {skill: .tool_input.skill, ts: (now | todate)}' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skill-usage.jsonl"; } 2>/dev/null; exit 0

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'HOOK ERROR: jq is not installed — required to parse hook input. Install jq (brew install jq).' >&2; exit 2; fi; input=$(cat); filepath=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -z "$filepath" ]; then echo 'HOOK ERROR: could not read .tool_input.file_path from stdin JSON — Claude Code hook input format may have changed. Skipping Prettier silently would hide this, so failing loudly.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ -z "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ]; then echo 'HOOK ERROR: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is unset — cannot locate the project root for Prettier. The variable name may have changed.' >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$filepath" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$filepath" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm prettier --write "$filepath";; *) exit 0;; esac
